caveats: This is a planning sample, not an official syllabus or an approved word list.
Headword matches do not establish that the correct sense is present or appropriate for children.
Unmatched strings are not a verified count of new Lexemes: aliases, inflections, variants and legacy sources still require review.
Alphabet and phoneme activities are not included in this inventory.
